description: EMPTY-GRANT ASYMMETRY (upstream behavior): a stored token with allowedConnections=[] / allowedActions=[] / allowedProxies=[] treats empty connection/action allowlists as ALLOW-ALL. The call to connection beta is NOT denied by the grant layer (contrast with cross_connection 403) and proceeds until the provider rejects the fake API key. This upstream behavior is the reason WeKnora NewGrant must reject empty grants locally instead of relying on [] to mean deny.

environment.database: sqlite at OOMOL_CONNECT_DATA_DIR=/tmp/oc-t01-data-a (throwaway, deleted after probes)
environment.runtime_auth: stored oct_ runtime tokens minted via POST /api/runtime-tokens
environment.node: host Node v26.7.0 running pinned sources via native TS execution; image probes use node:24-alpine build

setup: same dune alpha/beta connections as cross_connection
assertions: errorCode is authorization_failed from the dune API ('invalid API Key'), NOT connection_not_allowed
the connection grant layer allowed the call (allowedConnections=[] == allow-all) and the executor actually ran with the fake beta key
direct contrast: identical request with the alpha-only token (cross_connection fixture) returns connection_not_allowed
allowedProxies=[] is the OPPOSITE (deny-all proxies) — see proxy_denied fixture; this asymmetry is the core trap for the local grant model
